  3. <fidel-data-saver>

<fidel-data-saver>

Data saver: know the size first. Shows the size before anything downloads, with a choice of the full video or a smaller version.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Learners who pay for every megabyte of data.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት።

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-data-saver href="/files/lessons/ID/video.mp4" size="45000000"
                  alt-href="/api/v1/lessons/ID/offline.html" alt-size="3100000"
                  alt-label="audio and text version"></fidel-data-saver>

Source: player/src/components/b/data-saver.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-data-saver>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
hrefURLnoneThe big file. A video or audio file plays in place after "Load it"; any other file is a link.
sizebytesasked with HEAD, else "Size unknown"Its size.
alt-href, alt-size, alt-labelURL, bytes, textnoneThe smaller version (a link), its size and what it is.
captions, captions-lang, captions-labelURL (WebVTT), code, textcaptions-lang: enCaptions for the video.
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-data-saver>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-data-saver-choice{ choice } (full or light)The learner chose a version.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • "Load it" and the smaller version are a real button and a real link, each with its size.
  • If the phone asks to save data, the smaller version comes first and the component says why.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Its own buttons and messages are in English or Amharic. Set ui-lang="am" on the tag (or on a parent); without it, the page's lang is used, else English.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum): Buttons and links at least 44 × 44 px.
  • 1.3.1 Info and Relationships: Real buttons and links.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
